item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J03325","case1_error":"Omits the initial 50-yard width, treating the target width as the required increase.","case2_error":"Uses the time for one page as the time for 100 pages, omitting the 100-page factor.","reason":"The first omits an initial-value offset; the second fails to scale a per-page time by the number of pages.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03326","case1_error":"Introduces an unsupported $3,000 tax expense; 20% of the $5,000 pretax profit is $1,000.","case2_error":"Reports net spending of $23 as money remaining, instead of subtracting it from $74.","reason":"The first inserts an unjustified tax amount; the second calculates and reports the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03327","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 36 × 9 as 432 in the correctly formulated volume calculation.","case2_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 32 × 12 as 360 instead of 384.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate a correctly written multiplication expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J03328","case1_error":"Lists unsupported numerical answers after correct deposit formulas, without showing any numerical evaluation.","case2_error":"Replaces the exact increase factor 4/3 with 1.33, producing fractional guests and an incorrect total.","reason":"The first supplies unexplained numbers after correct formulas; the second visibly substitutes an inaccurate decimal for an exact fraction.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J03329","case1_error":"Gives an unsupported final average of 13 after correctly stating the sum-and-divide formula.","case2_error":"Subtracts the restaurant allocation twice, miscalculates the subtraction, introduces 56 bags without support, and incorrectly evaluates 408 ÷ 56.","reason":"The first has only an unsupported final number; the second shows an erroneous allocation relation and explicit arithmetic errors.","judgment":"different"}]}
